info.title: Comic Net Swing MVP / Shared REST API
info.description: Swing-first Phase2 contract. React TypeScript remains the future Web extension outside MVP. Business permissions, transactions, IDs, ETags and SQL2025 ownership remain backend-only. Local setup wizard is explicitly approved; backup/restore remains an operator procedure with Swing runbook/log viewer. Implementation and verification status is reported separately. Phase 3 extension: comic ratings and plain-text reviews, 1–5 stars; one current rating per user/comic with conditional mutations.
